subject: Important Update: Changes to Our Customer Support Hours
body: Dear valued customers, we wanted to inform you about some changes to our customer support hours. Starting next week, our customer support team will be available from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Monday to Friday. We believe this adjustment will help us provide you with better service and support. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to us. Thank you for your understanding and continued support.
